question:
I wrapped the Troubleshooting section of `buttons.md` in `<!-- test ignore start -->` and `<!-- test ignore end -->`, because its links point at internal hosts. The run still fails: a second test I never wrote, `buttons.md~7d7c74ca`, fails with `Returned 404. Expected one of [200,301,302,307,308]` on the support-portal link. The status-page link in the same section is skipped as expected. Here's the page:

```markdown
<!-- test {"testId": "buttons"} -->

Open the [demo page](http://localhost:8092/).

<!-- step {"goTo": "http://localhost:8092/"} -->

Click the button labeled Standard Button.

<!-- step {"click": "Standard Button"} -->

<!-- test ignore start -->

## Troubleshooting

If the button does nothing, check the [internal status page](http://localhost:8092/status/503).

<!-- test end -->

You can also ask in the [support portal](http://localhost:8092/status/404).

<!-- test ignore end -->
```

Why is one link inside the ignore block still checked?

facts.text: A `test end` statement also ends the ignore block, so everything after `<!-- test end -->` inside it is read and detected again.
The support-portal link is detected outside any test, so Doc Detective puts its `checkLink` step in a test it creates on its own, with a generated ID; that's the `buttons.md~7d7c74ca` test.
The fix is to move `<!-- test end -->` out of the ignore block, such as above `<!-- test ignore start -->`.

must_not: Ignore blocks don't apply to links, so links need `testIgnore` or a custom `markup` definition to be skipped.
An ignore block can't contain a heading, so the `## Troubleshooting` line ends it.
The second test comes from the step statements, which run twice.

run.does: that opens localhost:8092 and clicks "Standard Button"

wrong.why: clicks a button the page lacks
a statement prefix Doc Detective doesn't read
says ignore blocks skip only statements
wrong.answer: Ignore blocks only skip `step` statements, not detected links. To keep a link from being checked, add a custom `markup` definition to your config that excludes `localhost:8092/status` URLs.
